findings.title: Ceiling command omits unheld provider spend
findings.description: The 30-day cap command is calculated from `planned + trailing` only. However, the spend guard also includes unheld provider jobs in its 30-day total, and the estimate exposes those costs in `unheld_jobs` (`purchase_plan.py#plan_summary`, `spend_guard.py#evaluate_spend`). If an estimate has $89 planned, $0 trailing, and $20 unheld, this command sets the cap to $90 even though the spend guard needs at least $109. Following the printed command can therefore leave the purchase refused. Include unheld spend and align the cap calculation with the guard’s treatment of resubmits.

findings.title: Slice argument can escape the notes directory
findings.description: `--slice` is only checked for non-empty text, but it is interpolated into paths used for the baseline and start files. A value containing path traversal, such as `../../../../tmp/run`, can make those writes target files outside `NOTES_DIR`. Validate the slice as a safe identifier (for example, digits only) before using it in paths.
